correctness.rationale: The edge-rank equivalence is exact. With independent exponential edge clocks of rate 1/n, unseen-unseen edges form size-two clusters at rate u(u-1)/(2n), and unseen-to-size-j edges grow clusters at rate uj/n. Martingale quadratic variation is O(T/n) on bounded time intervals, yielding the finite ODE system via Gronwall. Its unique two-ancestor time-inhomogeneous Yule solution gives the proposed integral c_k. Unseen-vertex fraction has exact mean exp(-(n-1)T/n), bounding all later component-count changes and justifying the infinite-time limit. The sums of c_k and k c_k are evaluated by positive-term geometric identities; the latter equals one, proving conditional total-variation convergence of size distributions and absence of macroscopic components. Actual standalone VERIFY.py returned VERIFY_OK 121 assertions; numerical checks are explicitly non-proofs.

value.rationale: The whole size profile answers a mathematically natural fragmentation question absent from known component-number summaries. It distinguishes size-two and higher tree clusters, yields size-biased and component-uniform sampling laws, and proves no giant component by exact mass normalization. Its nontrivial time-inhomogeneous immigration/Yule mechanism is a structural explanation, not a routine restatement or isolated arbitrary constant.
